hypothesis: Combining generative and discriminative models through adversarial training will reduce output blurriness
prediction: Generative model output blurriness will decrease by at least 50% when trained with adversarial feedback from a discriminative model
measurement_method: Quantify blurriness using a standardized image sharpness metric (e.g., variance of Laplacian) on outputs before and after adversarial training
falsification_condition: If the measured blurriness decreases by less than 50% (i.e., ratio of post-training to pre-training blurriness > 0.5)
